title: CSV to JSON
seoTitle: Free CSV to JSON Converter — Private Browser Tool
description: Convert CSV or TSV data into JSON arrays of objects. Handles headers, custom delimiters, and quoted fields entirely in your browser.
intro: Paste CSV, choose delimiter and whether the first row is headers, then get clean JSON ready to use in code or APIs.
blurb: Turn CSV into JSON objects or arrays with proper quote and delimiter handling.
howItWorks: Paste your CSV or TSV content.
Select the delimiter and whether the first row contains column names.
Click Convert to JSON to produce an array of objects (or arrays if no headers).
examples: A header row plus data becomes [{ "name": "Ada", "role": "Engineer" }, ...].
Without headers you get arrays of values: [["Ada", "Engineer", "98"], ...].
Quoted fields containing commas are preserved correctly.

faq.a: Yes. Standard CSV quoting rules are followed so commas inside quotes stay inside the field.

faq.q: What if my CSV has empty lines?
faq.a: Empty lines are skipped. Trailing empty fields are kept.
